description.en: North East England is one of nine official regions of England. It consists of County Durham, Northumberland, Tyne and Wear and part of North Yorkshire.
description.zh-CN: 東北英格蘭，英國英格蘭下轄的9個次級行政區之一，東面臨海，主要以小型城市為主，包括新特蘭和紐卡素。
